preToolUse.bash: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f .github/hooks/packet-dispatcher-guard.ps1 ] || exit 0; pwsh -NoProfile -File .github/hooks/packet-dispatcher-guard.ps1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && exit 2; exit 0
